title: Confirm & Render: queue per-shot video jobs and charge credits
summary: Inserts one queued video_generation_jobs row per shot with a start-frame image URL, deducts the full scene total (all shots video cost + frame image costs) from user_credits, fires the executor, toasts, locks stage 11 (best-effort) and advances to stage 12.

summary: Stage 11 shows "Project total so far" = sum over all project jobs of actual_cost (completed) else estimated_cost (incl. failed). Hidden when 0.

preconditions: jobs exist (else "No Video Jobs" empty state)

notes: functional U: browser behavior only verifiable at runtime. With mock provider every clip is the same sample MP4.

entrypoint: Stage 12 Play Scene / big play button

notes: Segment widths use DB duration, not real media length (Veo clamps to 4/6/8; mock sample length differs).

preconditions: queued rows exist; executor not already running in this process

summary: Downloads start (and optional end) frame, base64 encodes, submits instances[{prompt,image,lastFrame}] with durationSeconds clamped to 4/6/8, generateAudio true, aspectRatio, personGeneration allow_adult, resizeMode pad; polls fetchPredictOperation every 10s up to 5 min; uploads mp4 to Supabase bucket videos.

context_inputs: start_frame_url image bytes, end_frame_url image bytes (if any), duration_seconds, model_variant, projects.aspect_ratio
output_parse: operation.done; error -> PERMANENT; raiMediaFilteredCount>0 -> PERMANENT; response.videos[0].bytesBase64Encoded or gcsUri
retry_fallback: no internal retry except continue on poll 5xx; executor re-queues any error up to 3 attempts; timeout 5 min -> TEMPORARY

Error codes TEMPORARY|PERMANENT|RATE_LIMIT|AUTH_ERROR|UNKNOWN with retryable flag that the executor ignores.

side_effects: scene badge status in Script Hub (statusConfig) and unlock warnings in projects.ts

summary: Confirm onSuccess -> handleSceneStageComplete locks stage 11 (best-effort, needs 10 locked) and moves to 12; Complete Scene locks 12 (needs 11 locked) and exits to hub. Lock failure only logged; navigation proceeds.

summary: modelVariant, expandedShots (Stage 11); currentShotIndex, isPlaying, isMuted, globalTimePosition, seekTarget, wasAllComplete (Stage 12); ShotListPanel expandedIndex; Unsatisfied selectedIssue/issueDescription. None persisted.

notes: Stage-lock outdated markers are the only staleness signal.
title: No invalidation of video jobs on upstream change
summary: Nothing updates/flags video_generation_jobs when frames are regenerated, prompts edited, or stages 7-11 unlocked. Old jobs keep playing in Stage 12 and keep counting for render status and running total.
ui_signal: none; Script Hub may still show Review Ready
evidence: grep video_generation_jobs: only checkout.ts, videoGenerationService.ts, VideoJobExecutor.ts, migration 021

title: Unlock impact counts videos from nonexistent table
summary: Stage unlock (sceneStageLocks) and shot-list unlock (projects.ts) count and "invalidate" rows in table videos which does not exist; videosAffected is always 0; estimatedCost = frames*0.05 + videos*2.50.
trigger: POST stage-locks/:n/unlock; shot-list unlock in projects.ts

title: Return-to-stage from Stage 12 does not unlock or invalidate
summary: handleReturnToStage only sets sceneStage state (7-12). No unlock, no job change, no localStorage persist; issue description dropped.

title: Prompt and frame URL snapshot at queue time
summary: Jobs store start/end frame URLs and video/frame prompt text at confirm; executor and retries use only the snapshot, so later edits to shots.video_prompt or frames do not affect queued/retried jobs.

title: Per-second pricing constants and cost formula
summary: VEO_31_FAST_RATE = 0.15, VEO_31_STANDARD_RATE = 0.40 ($/s). videoCost = round4(shots.duration * rate). shot total = frames.total_cost_credits(start) + frames.total_cost_credits(end row if any) + videoCost. scene total = sum over all shots.

title: Pricing rates duplicated in six places
summary: 0.15/0.40 hard-coded in videoGenerationService constants, MockVideoProvider.estimateCost, Veo3Provider.estimateCost, checkoutService.getModelRate (unused), Stage 11 UI copy strings, migration 021 comments.

notes: Units: frame costs are "credits" (NanoBanana 0.01 per 512x512), video costs are $/s; summed and displayed as $.
title: Charged amount includes skipped shots and frame image costs
summary: confirm-render deducts sceneTotal for the variant, which sums video cost for every shot (including those skipped for lacking a start frame URL) plus all frame total_cost_credits. Image generation itself never touches user_credits.

title: Re-confirming a scene creates duplicate jobs and charges again
summary: No check for existing jobs or stage 11 lock in confirm-render; the Stage 11 Confirm button stays enabled when stage 11 is locked. Stage 12 then lists all historical jobs (labels by job index).

title: Charging uses un-clamped duration; Veo bills clamped 4/6/8
summary: estimated_cost and deduction use shots.duration; Veo3 clamps to nearest of 4/6/8 and records actual_cost from clamped value; no reconciliation with user_credits.

title: No refund, no top-up, no payment integration
summary: Failed jobs, skipped shots, and cost differences are never refunded. addCredits exists but has no caller; no purchase/top-up route.

title: Insert-then-deduct is non-atomic
summary: Jobs inserted before deductCredits; if deduction throws (amount<=0, concurrent drain, DB error) the route 500s but queued jobs remain uncharged and the executor is not triggered by this call. Balance update is read-modify-write without locking.

title: Executor is global, serial, in-memory, and has no recovery
summary: One loop per backend process; oldest queued job across all users; isProcessing flag in memory; pollIntervalMs unused; no startup trigger; jobs stuck in processing/generating/uploading after a restart are never reset and cannot be retried (retry requires failed).

title: Auto-retry ignores retryable flag; manual retry gets one attempt
summary: Executor re-queues on any error until attempt_count reaches max_retries (3 total attempts), including PERMANENT safety-filter errors. Manual retry leaves attempt_count >= 3 so the next failure is final.

title: Veo3 storage_path recorded does not match uploaded object
summary: Upload key is `${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}/${timestamp}.mp4` in bucket videos; returned storagePath is `videos/${GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT}/${Date.now()}.mp4` with a separate Date.now(); folder is GCP project id, not app project.

notes: High confidence; runtime would confirm PostgREST error.
title: Prior-scene mismatch warning broken by wrong column name
summary: getDependencyWarnings selects scenes.end_frame_thumbnail; migration 013 created end_frame_thumbnail_url. Query returns error/null so priorSceneMismatch is always false.

title: Frames used regardless of status; end frame sent even if not required
summary: Any frame row with image_url is used (rejected/generating included). end_frame_url set whenever an end frame row has an image, even when requires_end_frame is false; Veo then receives lastFrame.

title: Retry and single-job routes do not verify job ownership
summary: R5 and R8 verify only that the caller owns :projectId, then operate on any :jobId. Backend uses service role key, so RLS does not apply.

title: No stitching, export, editing, separate audio or voice
summary: Scene playback is client-side sequencing of per-shot MP4 URLs. Export buttons disabled. Only audio source is Veo generateAudio:true (mock: sample file audio). No ffmpeg/TTS/stitch code in repo.

title: Render-status aggregation rule
summary: all completed -> complete; all failed -> failed; any active -> rendering; some completed and some failed -> partial; else pending. Computed over all historical jobs of a scene. Script Hub reacts only to complete and rendering.

title: Active-status list duplicated across layers
summary: ['queued','processing','generating','uploading'] repeated in checkout.ts, videoGenerationService (2x), checkoutService, Stage12VideoGeneration, VideoPlayer.

title: Video env vars absent from env templates
summary: VIDEO_PROVIDER, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS are not in backend/env.example or backend/.env (name-only check). backend/.env is untracked.

title: Veo poll timing and limits
summary: POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000, POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 5*60*1000 per attempt; up to 3 attempts per job serially, so a single Veo job can hold the global loop ~15 min.

title: IssueResolutionSection component
summary: Full issue-type picker + confirm modal; not imported anywhere. UnsatisfiedDropdown duplicates its behavior and is the live one.
evidence: grep IssueResolutionSection: only own file + types.ts

title: Unused checkoutService helpers
summary: getCreditBalance, getVideoJobStatus, getSceneRenderStatus, getActiveJobCount, formatCost, getModelRate, getModelName have no callers.

title: Legacy types SceneCheckout, VideoClip, SceneReview
summary: Defined in src/types/scene.ts, referenced nowhere else.

title: userCreditsService.addCredits
summary: Top-up method with no caller and no route.

title: VideoJobExecutor.pollIntervalMs and frame_prompt_snapshot usage
summary: pollIntervalMs = 5000 declared, never read. frame_prompt_snapshot stored on jobs but never sent to providers or shown.

title: Stage 11 LockedStageHeader "Confirm & Render" label
summary: lockAndProceedLabel passed without onLockAndProceed, so the header lock button never renders. priorSceneEndFrameUrl returned but never displayed.

title: Comment/UI claims contradicting behavior in slice
summary: "Skip shots without approved start frame" checks only URL; "No further edits are possible after confirmation" is not enforced; executor header claims polling; "uploading" status is set after upload; modal says "video jobs will be preserved" (vacuously true).

title: No automated tests for checkout, credits, video jobs, providers, Stage 11/12
summary: No jest test (testMatch **/*.test.ts) or vitest __tests__ or Playwright spec references this slice. veo3-test.ts is a manual tsx script making a live Vertex call; connectivity-test.ts covers DB/LangSmith/Gemini only.
